chunks: He manifested whatever he was commanded, and conveyed the message of his Lord. Consequently, Allah repaired the cracks through him, joined the slits through him, and reconciled through him the relatives, after the deep-seated enmity in the chests and the burning grudges in the hearts.
ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet's mission heal social divisions according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this passage from Nahj al-Balagha emphasizes the Prophet's role as the ultimate unifier (Mu'allif al-Qulub), transforming the pre-Islamic era of tribal fragmentation (Jahiliyyah) into a cohesive community bound by kinship and faith. It underscores the divine efficacy of his message in healing not just social discord but the deep-seated spiritual enmity (Daghinah) within the hearts of the Arabs.
